title: Signed Hamming tail coefficient
statement: For a real threshold $t$ and a natural number $m$, define the signed Hamming tail parameter to be the absolute value of twice the Fourier coefficient of the Hamming upper-tail indicator on the $(m+1)$-dimensional sign cube at the singleton set containing coordinate $0$.
caveat: The payload does not define the Hamming upper-tail indicator or its Fourier coefficient convention.
